package_delivery.label: Package delivery scam
package_delivery.description: Fake delivery notices that claim a parcel is held until you pay a small fee or confirm your address.
red_flags: A tiny 'redelivery' or 'customs' fee you weren't expecting
Tracking link that isn't the carrier's real website
next_steps: Don't tap the link
Check tracking in the carrier's official app or by typing its address yourself
Forward the text to 7726 (SPAM), then delete it

bank_impersonation.label: Bank impersonation
bank_impersonation.description: Messages or calls pretending to be your bank's fraud team to steal logins, codes or money.
red_flags: Pressure to act right now to 'protect' or 'unlock' your account
Asks you to read back a code or move money to a 'safe' account
next_steps: Don't reply or call numbers in the message
Call the number on the back of your card or open your bank's official app
Never share one-time codes with anyone

toll_fee.label: Unpaid toll / fee scam
toll_fee.description: Texts claiming you owe a small toll, parking or ticket fee with a threat of big late penalties.
red_flags: Small balance plus a big threatened late fee
Payment link on an odd domain, not the agency's official site
next_steps: Don't tap the link
Log in to your toll account through its official website or app
Forward the text to 7726 (SPAM)

prize_giveaway.label: Prize / giveaway scam
prize_giveaway.description: 'You won' messages that ask for card details, a shipping fee or personal info to claim a reward.
red_flags: You won something you never entered
Asks for a fee or card number to 'release' the prize
next_steps: Don't enter card or personal details
Check the store's official site or app for real promotions
Delete the message

job_offer.label: Fake job offer
job_offer.description: Too-good-to-be-true remote jobs that end in paying 'fees', laundering money or handing over ID.
red_flags: High pay for little work and no interview
Asks you to pay for equipment or move to a chat app
next_steps: Don't pay any fee or share ID documents
Look up the company yourself and apply through its official careers page
Report the message to the platform it came from

tech_support.label: Tech support scam
tech_support.description: Fake virus alerts, renewal invoices or 'refund' notices that push you to call or install remote-access tools.
red_flags: Unexpected invoice or virus alert with a phone number to call
Asks you to install remote-access software or 'update' files
next_steps: Don't call the number or install anything
Close the page; check subscriptions in the vendor's official account page
If you already gave access, disconnect and run a trusted security scan

account_verification.label: Account verification phish
account_verification.description: 'Verify your account', 'mailbox full' or 'password expires' messages leading to fake login pages.
red_flags: Threat that your account will be locked or deleted
Login link whose domain doesn't match the service
next_steps: Don't log in through the link
Open the service by typing its address or using the app
If you entered a password, change it and turn on MFA

gift_card_request.label: Gift card / urgent payment request
gift_card_request.description: Someone posing as a boss, relative or official asks you to buy gift cards or send money fast and quietly.
red_flags: Asks for gift cards, wire or crypto as payment
Secrecy and urgency: 'don't tell anyone, I need it now'
next_steps: Don't buy gift cards or send money
Verify by calling the person on a number you already know
Report it to your workplace IT or security team if it came at work

romance.label: Romance scam
romance.description: An online love interest builds trust, then needs money for travel, customs, medical bills or 'investments'.
red_flags: Avoids video calls or meeting in person
Emergencies that can only be solved with your money
next_steps: Don't send money or gifts
Talk to a friend or family member you trust
Report the profile on the app or site where you met

crypto_investment.label: Crypto / investment scam
crypto_investment.description: Promises of guaranteed or fast returns on crypto or trading platforms you've never heard of.
red_flags: Guaranteed returns or 'double your money'
Pressure to deposit more or pay a fee to withdraw
next_steps: Don't deposit or 'pay to withdraw'
Only use regulated, well-known platforms you find yourself
Stop contact and report it

legitimate.label: Looks legitimate
red_flags: Still double-check unexpected requests
Use the official app if you're unsure
next_steps: No action needed
If something feels off, open the official app or site yourself
